parts.official_mark_scheme_text: State or imply $u^2-u-12=0$, or an equivalent equation in $3^x$ [B1; the work must show awareness that $3^{2x}=(3^x)^2$]. Solve for $u$, or $3^x$, and obtain root 4 [B1]. Use a correct method to solve $3^x=a$ for $a>0$, e.g. $x\ln3=\ln a$ or $x=\log_3a$ [M1; do not penalise an attempt to use the negative root too]. Obtain $x=1.26$ only [A1; 2 d.p. required]. Total 4.
